guard.note: Mowzie's Mobs 1.21.1-1.8.2: a new TextureStateShard and CompositeState (beacon beam shader, translucent, no cull, overlay, colour write), then create("glow_effect", NEW_ENTITY, QUADS, 256, true, true, state)
the same with no depth test and no overlay, then create("solar_flare", NEW_ENTITY, QUADS, 256, true, false, state)
a new CompositeRenderType from its arguments (the factory both the original and the switch call)

mowziesmobs_effect_render_state_memo.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapMethod on MMRenderType.getGlowingEffect and getSolarFlare: the first call per texture runs the original and keeps its render type's parameters and render state; later calls make a new render type from them through RenderType.create (the factory the original calls; reflection, once), so every call still returns a new object (helper bons.furious.patch.mowziesmobs_client_c49.EffectStates; shadow mode compares every call)

guard.note: Mowzie's Mobs 1.21.1-1.8.2: super call, shouldRenderSun, isHidden return, then one pushPose, one translateToPivotPoint, the "sun_render" name test (the drawing), getBuffer(renderType) and one popPose
GeckoLib 4.9.3: one PoseStack.translate by the bone's pivot

mowziesmobs_umvuthana_layer_bone_test.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the PoseStack.pushPose, RenderUtil.translateToPivotPoint and PoseStack.popPose calls of UmvuthiSunLayer.renderForBone (@Share per call): for a bone whose name is not the layer's sun bone the three calls are left out; the super call, conditions, name test and getBuffer call stay (helper bons.furious.patch.mowziesmobs_client_c49.LayerBoneScan). Mowzie's Mobs 1.21.1-1.8.2's UmvuthanaArmorLayer and UmvuthanaSunLayer have no renderForBone (they draw once per frame from the bone's tracked pose), so the Forge build's two other wrappers have no target here
